performance_review.conclusion: Bundling only historical interior missing ranges into bounded SDK query windows is a reasonable optimization under the listed invariants; no speedup has been measured
performance_review.current_behavior: Each missing range invokes an initial SDK request plus up to three retries, with a total of six seconds sleep for persistently empty responses
invariants: Group only exact feed, server, symbol, and timeframe matches
Use finalized cached bar boundaries present before the query; exclude open or provisional boundaries
Keep edge ranges and isolated long ranges on their existing path
Bound combined windows to at most 31 days
Clip the returned bars to the original missing subranges before in-memory merging
Store and record attempts per original subrange, never as the full combined bridge window
Do not overwrite cached bars in the bridge between gaps
Preserve 24-hour interior attempt TTL and 60-second edge/provisional refresh behavior
Requests and negative attempt records do not prove bar coverage
Do not interrupt the active production run or assume already-imported code has changed
required_regressions: Reduced SDK query count for many small internal gaps
No cached bridge-bar overwrite even if SDK returns different OHLC
Empty and partial responses preserve bars and per-original-range TTL
Feed isolation, stale provisional bars, request boundaries, and missing coverage remain unchanged
